items.title: Listen to Tim Cook's first and last earnings calls as Apple CEO
items.summary: Tim Cook has left a lasting legacy at Apple (AAPL), from his first earnings call as CEO in 2011 to his last one in 2026. Cook will step down as CEO on September 1, 2026 passing the baton to John Ternus, Apple's Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering.

items.title: Where Apple is diverging from rest of Mag 7 earnings
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) stock continues to drop on Friday while shares of Amazon (AMZN) surge since the two tech giants posted earnings results yesterday. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley and Trustless Media Founder Zack Guzman take a closer look at the key figures that Apple reported in its earnings release.

items.title: Apple earnings: iPhone prices are 'not immune' to rising memory costs
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) stock is stumbling in Thursday's after-hours since reporting fiscal third quarter earnings and revenue that topped estimates, carried by strong iPhone sales. New Street Research technology Infrastructure analyst Antoine Chkaiban explains the problem areas that could emerge down the line for Apple tied to the memory chip shortage.

items.title: Apple exceeds Q3 earnings estimates, boasts $109.4 billion in revenue
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) released results for its fiscal third quarter, revealing earnings of $2.02 per share (vs. estimates of $1.80) and revenue of $109.42 billion (vs. estimates of $108.85 billion). The stock is ticking lower in Thursday's after-hours trading. Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton dives into Apple's earnings figures.
